resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent primary sources confirm operating status. (1) 2021-08-29 single-source-procurement notice (广西信永工程咨询有限责任公司 via 采招网, archived as an image, archive.org item 2023-09-19-195825, HTTP 200; automated text screen FAILs because it is a screenshot image with no extractable text layer -- I downloaded the PNG and read it directly): states the 中缅管道钦州支线 (this pipeline) 'currently running at 6MPa' (目前运行压力为6MPa), i.e. actively conveying gas as of the notice date. (2) An archived CNPC/PipeChina Southwest Pipeline Branch facilities table (web.archive.org snapshot of cnpc.com.cn, HTTP 200 -- automated substring screen FAILs on this token too because the PDF's extracted text layer doesn't register a plain match, but I ran `pdftotext -layout` myself and the exact row is present) lists 中缅钦州支线 as an in-service facility of 西南管道分公司 commissioned 2014/7/6, i.e. long-operating with no indication of shutdown. Both false negatives are the documented url_verifier false-negative classes (image-only page; PDF text-extraction miss) -- content manually confirmed to support 'operating'.

Two independent sources confirm this is a natural-gas pipeline. (1) The CNPC facilities table (pdftotext-verified) lists 中缅钦州支线 under section header '三、天然气管道' (III. Natural Gas Pipelines), directly under CNPC's Southwest Pipeline Branch table -- unambiguous classification as gas, separate from the document's section I (crude oil) and II (refined products). (2) The 2021 procurement notice (read as image) states the branch runs '起自西二线南宁支干线的南宁末站' (originating from the West-East Gas Pipeline No.2 Nanning trunk-branch's Nanning terminal), i.e. it is a branch off a natural-gas trunk system, with volumetric throughput given in 万m³/d (cubic meters, the standard gas unit, not tons). Both confirm Fuel=Gas.

Single strong primary source: the CNPC/Southwest Pipeline Branch facilities table row for 中缅钦州支线 gives 投产时间 (commissioning date) 2014/7/6, matching recorded StartYear1=2014 exactly (verified via `pdftotext -layout`, which the automated verifier's substring screen missed -- documented PDF-extraction false negative). The 2021 procurement notice (my other source for this row) is a technical/relocation document and does not state a commissioning date, so this is a one-source confirmation -- tier medium, not high, though the source is authoritative (CNPC's own facilities register).

CNPC facilities table row for 中缅钦州支线 states 设计能力 (design capacity) = 14.4 亿方/年 = 1.44 bcm/y, an exact match to recorded Capacity=1.44/CapacityUnits=bcm/y (pdftotext-verified; automated substring screen false-negatived on this large PDF). Single source for this exact annual-capacity figure, so tier medium. Note for transparency, not a contradiction: the 2021 procurement notice separately states 'design throughput 700万m³/d' for the same branch -- a different technical parameter (a nameplate/peak daily flow figure for the relocation engineering scope) that does not correspond 1:1 to an annual-average capacity figure and is not being proposed as a competing Capacity value; only the CNPC table's matching annual figure is cited here.

Two independent sources give near-identical lengths for the same route (南宁末站 to 钦州港/广西石化炼厂末站): (1) 2021 procurement notice (read as image): '线路水平长约141.156km'; (2) CNPC facilities table (pdftotext-verified): 141.2 km. Both round to the recorded LengthKnown=141.00km within normal survey-vs-design rounding tolerance. High tier, independent sources (an engineering procurement notice vs. an internal corporate facilities register).

The 2021 procurement notice (read as image; automated text screen FAILs because it's a screenshot with no text layer) states '管径D813mm' for this exact branch (中缅管道钦州支线), an exact match to recorded Diameter=813/DiameterUnits=mm. The CNPC facilities table (my other source for this row) does not include a diameter column, so this is a single-source confirmation -- tier medium. This also resolves an initial suspicion (raised in the prior deep-sweep audit) that the 813mm value might be cross-contaminated from a different roster row (P4719, also 813mm) -- it is not; it is independently, directly sourced here for this specific segment.

Two independent sources confirm the Nanning->Qinzhou route. (1) 2021 procurement notice: '起自西二线南宁支干线的南宁末站，止于钦州港广西石化炼厂末站' (starts at the Nanning terminal station off the West-East Gas Pipeline No.2 Nanning branch, ends at the Qinzhou Port Guangxi Petrochemical refinery terminal station) -- confirms StartPrefecture=Nanning, EndPrefecture=Qinzhou, both Guangxi/China. (2) CNPC facilities table: row '中缅钦州支线, 西二线南宁站-钦州港站' (走向/位置 = route Nanning Station to Qinzhou Port Station), 途经省市 (province) = 广西 (Guangxi). Both independently corroborate start/end locations and province.

The source document is titled '西南管道分公司油气管网设施基本情况表' (Southwest Pipeline Branch Company Oil & Gas Pipeline Network Facilities Table) and lists 中缅钦州支线 as one of its facilities -- i.e. the operating entity at time of document (a CNPC branch company, pre-dating the 2019-2020 national pipeline-network reform that folded CNPC/Sinopec/CNOOC long-distance pipeline branch companies into 国家管网集团/PipeChina, generally under continuity-preserving renamed entities such as '国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司' for the former 西南管道分公司). I could not find a second, independent source explicitly naming '国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司' in connection with this specific branch or with Guangxi generally (WebSearch budget was exhausted this session; a follow-up search is recommended). Tier medium, single source, with the pre/post-reform entity-naming bridge flagged as a caveat rather than presented as a second independent confirmation.

Same source and same caveat as the Operator [ref] unit above: the document lists 中缅钦州支线 as a facility of 西南管道分公司 (CNPC's Southwest Pipeline Branch), the pre-2019-reform predecessor entity of the recorded Owner1='National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co Ltd' (100%). Single-source, tier medium; no second independent source found naming the current PipeChina entity specifically for this branch (WebSearch budget exhausted this session).
